# `vmafx/types.h`

Status codes, shared enumerations and the export macros.

`#include <vmafx/types.h>`.

## Status codes

| Code | Value | libvmaf errno | Since | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VMAFX_OK` | 0 | `0` | 0.1 | Success. |
| `VMAFX_PENDING` | 1 | `-EAGAIN` | 0.1 | The requested score is not final yet (libvmaf returned -EAGAIN). |
| `VMAFX_E_INVALID` | -1 | `-EINVAL` | 0.1 | Invalid argument or state; the error names the parameter. |
| `VMAFX_E_NOMEM` | -2 | `-ENOMEM` | 0.1 | Out of memory. |
| `VMAFX_E_NOTSUP` | -3 | `-ENOTSUP` | 0.1 | Backend, format or option not supported; the error names it. |
| `VMAFX_E_NOTFOUND` | -4 | `-ENOENT` | 0.1 | Unknown feature, model, extractor index or device. |
| `VMAFX_E_BUSY` | -5 | `-EBUSY` | 0.1 | Resource already in use. |
| `VMAFX_E_DEVICE` | -6 | `-EIO` | 0.1 | Backend runtime failure; the error carries the runtime's code. |
| `VMAFX_E_IO` | -7 | `-EIO` | 0.1 | File or stream error. |
| `VMAFX_E_RANGE` | -8 | `-ERANGE` | 0.1 | Value out of range. |
| `VMAFX_E_INTERNAL` | -9 | `-EIO` | 0.1 | Engine error without a more specific status; the error carries the engine's errno. |
